item.description:
PS Nest 1.2.0 — In-app updates

  • The Mac app checks for new versions when it opens and periodically afterwards.
  • Use Check for updates at the top of the window to check at any time.
  • Read the release notes and choose when to install and restart.
  • Running nests, imports and downloads must finish before installation.
  • Your current form is restored after restart; saved jobs and artwork stay on your Mac.
  • Includes the prominent offcut-cut toggle, enabled by default for new sheet jobs.

Mac versions 1.1.0 and earlier need one manual replacement to enable this updater. Windows updating is unchanged.
